snippet.title: Chef's Dogma Trailer
snippet.description:
Try Demo for free:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4520010/Chefs_Dogma/

Chef’s Dogma is a Roguelite Turn-Based battler where you journey through the 7-layers of bean dip hell. Upgrade your team through Stats, Items, or ‘Entree’s creating even stronger foods. Experience a multitude of Play-styles, Enemies, and Locations to help the Chef ascend into purgatory…
